entities.name: Raúl Duarte
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Raúl Duarte Mungi is a Peruvian basketball player. He competed in the men's tournament at the 1964 Summer Olympics. Duarte's brothers, Enrique, Luis, and Ricardo were also professional basketball players. All four of them were during the 1964 Olympics.
